Book correction: The book prints the lower limit of the sum as k = 1: \sum_{k=1}^{n} r^k = \frac{r^{n+1} - 1}{r - 1}. This statement is false: for n = 1 the left side is r but the right side is \frac{r^2 - 1}{r - 1} = r + 1. The formula is true when the sum starts at k = 0, as proved above.
